assets.name: Northstar Rescue title logotype
assets.notes: Compass-star emblem with elongated north point, layered NORTHSTAR wordmark (glow/stroke/gradient fill), RESCUE strip with amber diamonds, tagline. Entrance animation, drifting tick ring (reduced-motion aware).

assets.name: Star/compass emblem
assets.notes: 24-tick compass ring + two-layer star. Ring group spins as the loading/boot indicator (.spin).

assets.name: Title snow drift layer
assets.notes: 110 flakes, cosmeticRng seeded, runs only while the title screen is visible; disabled by reduced-motion.

assets.name: Title screen
assets.notes: Logotype over live 3D scene, radial scrim, cinematic top/bottom bars, snow layer, staggered menu entrance, station corner tag, credits footer.

assets.name: Settings panel
assets.notes: Grouped sections (Controls / Video / Accessibility / Audio), live mono value chips, control reference grid.

assets.name: Difficulty select
assets.notes: Three insignia cards with per-tier accent (cyan/amber/red), threat pips, hover lift.

assets.name: Mission briefing dossier
assets.notes: Classified-document chrome (dossier header, REF number, CLASSIFIED stamp), typographic hierarchy, OBJ-xx list, blueprint schematic plate.

assets.name: Loadout screen
assets.notes: Weapon cards with lit presentation stage, EQUIPPED flag, DMG/ROF/RNG bars, mag/action meta row, standard-equipment chips.

assets.name: Loading screen
assets.notes: Spinning compass ring, indeterminate bar, FIELD NOTE tip presentation (cosmeticRng rotation).

assets.name: Pause overlay
assets.notes: Radial vignette veil (+ backdrop blur where available) over the frozen world.

assets.name: Victory debrief
assets.notes: Cold-blue triumph wash, gradient banner, debrief kicker, mono stats strip.

assets.name: Defeat debrief
assets.notes: Red-washed failure treatment, distinct rule/stats border tint.

assets.name: HUD vitals block
assets.notes: Health/armor bars with quarter ticks, mono numerals, hurt state (red border + pulsing bar) below 35 HP.

assets.name: HUD ammo block
assets.notes: 32px mono mag counter (amber low / blinking red empty), reserve, weapon silhouette + name, slot dots, RELOADING state line.

assets.name: HUD objectives tracker
assets.notes: Checkbox states: active (pulsing cyan + inner dot), done (green check + strike), pending hidden.

assets.name: Hostage status chips
assets.notes: States UNKNOWN/LOCATED/WITH YOU/HOLDING/SAFE/LOST, shape-coded glyphs so colour is never the only signal.

assets.name: Tac-map panel
assets.notes: 2x supersampled canvas, crisp walls/doors, view-cone player arrow, extraction diamond + radius ring, hostage pips (amber dot -> cyan triangle), floor badge FL G / FL 1.

assets.name: Dynamic crosshair
assets.notes: Spread-driven gap, hairline ticks + centre dot; .ch-dot variant class ready for a style option.

assets.name: Hit/kill markers
assets.notes: Subtle white ticks; headshot kill variant in danger red, slightly larger.

assets.name: Damage feedback
assets.notes: Red radial vignette + conic-gradient direction arc (masked ring segment).

assets.name: Meridian LR-8 scope overlay
assets.notes: Circular blackout, inner ring, fine cross with 7-mil marks + even-mil numerals, inset vignette.

assets.name: Interaction prompt
assets.notes: Key glyph (kbd) + uppercase label, cyan-edged plate.

assets.name: Subtitle bar
assets.notes: 16px line on rgba(4,8,13,0.66) plate; honours the subtitles setting.

assets.name: Weapon side-profile icon set
assets.notes: 8 original profiles (Karst P9, Boreal K5, Halcyon HC-4, Vanta S-12, Meridian LR-8, Fieldman CQ, FB-3, SG-2) in 140x48, layered body/detail/line fills.

assets.name: Difficulty insignia set
assets.notes: Shield + chevron (Recruit), shield + northstar (Operator), shield + triple chevron (Veteran); shape-coded, accent-tinted per card.

assets.name: Hostage state glyphs
assets.notes: Dashed circle / diamond / triangle / pause bars / check / cross — one shape per state.

assets.name: Briefing floor-plan plate
assets.notes: Blueprint plate: survey grid, framed corner ticks, two-floor plans with room callouts, hatched atrium void, ENTRY/EXFIL/HOSTAGE? markers, north rose, 10m scale bar.
